caption_source.description: Caption JSON transcribed/converted off-render; render path reads JSON only

timing_clock.description: ms converted to frames (ms * fps / 1000); Sequence from/durationInFrames

animate_in_out.description: fade/slide via interpolate(frame, range, [0,1]); never CSS transition/animation

karaoke_highlight.description: per-word reveal via interpolate on the word frame; deterministic

transcribe_scope.description: transcription/SRT-parse off-render; never in the per-frame render path

determinism_contract.description: no Math.random/Date.now/new Date/fetch/setTimeout/setInterval; live transcribe forbidden in render path
